topic.summary: The Short of the 28 Nov long on the same subject (founder, 28 Nov 2026: 'on same topic you make short of that sona chandi ke rates kyun gire'). One clear answer in under a minute: how far gold and silver fell and in how many days (check peak and current prices against LBMA, MCX, COMEX), the two or three causes that mattered most (the dollar and interest-rate expectations, profit-booking after the rally, exchange margin changes), why silver fell further, and the one mistake buyers make. Explanation only, no advice to buy or sell. Point to the long video for the full study.
